mapper.select: SELECT member_id, residence_region, desired_job, desired_region, employment_type, career_type, career_years, min_salary, introduction, remote_preferred, flexible_preferred, hybrid_preferred, onsite_preferred, wheelchair_required, accessible_restroom_required, disabled_parking_required, assistive_device_required FROM job_seeker_profile WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT J.id, J.company_member_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.salary_max, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.remote_available, J.flexible_work_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.deadline, J.status, J.created_at, J.updated_at FROM job_posting J, company_profile C WHERE J.company_member_id = C.member_id AND J.status = 'OPEN' AND (J.deadline IS NULL OR J.deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY J.deadline IS NULL, J.deadline, J.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_job_posting_recommendation SET total_score = #{totalScore}, job_score = #{jobScore}, job_match_source = #{jobMatchSource}, job_match_reason = #{jobMatchReason}, region_score = #{regionScore}, employment_score = #{employmentTypeScore}, career_score = #{careerScore}, salary_score = #{salaryScore}, work_style_score = #{workStyleScore}, accessibility_score = #{accessibilityScore}, recommendation_reason = #{recommendationReason}, mismatch_reason = #{mismatchReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_job_posting_recommendation ( member_id, job_id, total_score, job_score, job_match_source, job_match_reason, region_score, employment_score, career_score, salary_score, work_style_score, accessibility_score, recommendation_reason, mismatch_reason ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{jobId}, #{totalScore}, #{jobScore}, #{jobMatchSource}, #{jobMatchReason}, #{regionScore}, #{employmentTypeScore}, #{careerScore}, #{salaryScore}, #{workStyleScore}, #{accessibilityScore}, #{recommendationReason}, #{mismatchReason} )
